messages:
maria: quick one — can we standardize env var names & precedence across SDKs for API keys/org/project scoping? i keep hitting parity bugs during onboarding and rotation tooling ignores some SDKs :grimacing:
raj: yes please. which inconsistencies are blocking you rn?
maria: node sdk expects REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_ORG, python uses REDWOOD_KEY + REDWOOD_PROJECT, go reads REDWOOD_TOKEN. rotation helper only writes REDWOOD_API_KEY so older SDKs don't pick up new keys.
claudia: fwiw security prefers explicit names + a file-backed option for HSM/KMS (so we don't put long-lived keys in envs). suggest REDWOOD_KEY_PATH for that.
alex: also need a clear precedence policy — sometimes we want per-route keys (eg customer-specific) vs org-default.
raj: agreed. propose this minimal spec:
1) env var names (new canonical): `REDWOOD_API_KEY` (token string), `REDWOOD_KEY_PATH` (file path to token), `REDWOOD_ORG` (org id), `REDWOOD_PROJECT` (project id)
2) precedence when resolving effective credentials: per-request header > SDK runtime override > env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY` > contents of `REDWOOD_KEY_PATH` > instance metadata/service account fallback
3) rotation behavior: SDKs must support hot-reload of `REDWOOD_KEY_PATH` (watch file mtime) and expose `reload_credentials()` API for processes that set envs and send SIGHUP
raj: i'll draft PRs for node/python/go to align names + add reload hook.
claudia: add requirement that SDKs never log full key value; mask on error messages. and require an opt-in telemetry flag for key-change events (no key contents, just "rotated").
maria: sample snippet for precedence we can copy into repos:
```
// pseudocode
if (request.headers.authorization) use that
else if (sdk.overrideKey) use that
else if (env.REDWOOD_API_KEY) use that
else if (file.exists(env.REDWOOD_KEY_PATH)) use file.read
else use metadata.service_account()
```
raj: nice. will include tests for each fallback. also add an integration test where rotation-bot writes a new file to REDWOOD_KEY_PATH and we assert SDK reloads within 2s.
rotation-bot: [system] rotation triggered for org=org_123. new key written to /var/run/redwood/key-org_123
maria: perfect — timeline? deprecate old vars (REDWOOD_KEY, REDWOOD_TOKEN) with a 3 month window and a compatibility shim that maps old->new with WARN logs for one week.
alex: ops will update rotation-bot to write both `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env (for simple containers) and `REDWOOD_KEY_PATH` (for k8s secrets) during rollout. we'll coordinate with infra team.
raj: i'll open the umbrella issue and add checklist: update env parsing, add file-watch, add reload API, add tests, update docs, add changelog + migration guide.
claudia: i'll review security checklist + suggest CLI to rotate and audit.
maria: thanks — assigning: raj (implement SDK changes), alex (rotation-bot/infrastructure), claudia (sec review), maria (docs + migration notes). ping me when PRs opened :thumbsup:
raj: on it. starting with node + python today :rocket:
maria: perfect, cheers everyone.
